2607.05104.title: Grokking Is Conditional and Fragile: A Fully-Tractable, Multi-Seed Study at 12K Parameters
2607.05104.paper_summary: Grokking -- the delayed onset of generalization long after a network has fit its training set - -is usually studied in models too large to read completely and reported from single training runs. We instead study a publicly released ~11,856-parameter Llama-style transformer (Glimmer-1-Base) on modular arithmetic, small enough to enumerate its weights, attention, and full input-output map, and we measure grokking as a multi-seed rate rather than a single outcome. In this fully-tractable regime grokking is a conditional, fragile phase transition. It is gated by training-set coverage, whose threshold tracks output cardinality (the modulus) more than task structure, an ordering that holds above the transition and across a ten-fold change in domain size. Weight decay reproduces the Omnigrok inverted-U at 12K parameters, a positive control on the rate measurement. Grokking also sits on a numerical knife-edge: two perturbations of the floating-point environment -- CPU thread count (reduction order) and CPU-versus-GPU execution -- each flip a minority of same-seed outcomes without a detectable shift in the aggregate rate. Decomposition into sub-task specialists helps chiefly by making coverage cheap rather than by adding supervision. Methodologically, multi-seed control under a fixed numerical environment overturns three dramatic single-run narratives in our own data, each a seed confound. The unit of evidence for grokking must therefore be a multi-seed rate under a pinned numerical environment, checked where possible against a direct reading of the model.
2607.05104.paper_summary_zh: Grokking -- 在網絡適應其訓練集後很久才出現的普遍化延遲發作 -- 通常在過於龐大的模型中進行研究，這些模型無法完全閱讀，並且報告來自單次訓練運行。我們則研究了一個公開發布的約11,856參數的Llama風格Transformer（Glimmer-1-Base），該模型在模組算術上足夠小，可以列舉其權重、注意力和完整的輸入-輸出映射，我們將grokking測量為多種種子的比率，而不是單一結果。在這個完全可處理的範疇中，grokking是一種條件性、脆弱的相變化。它受到訓練集覆蓋的限制，其閾值更能追蹤輸出基數（模數），而非任務結構，這種排序在相變化以上以及在十倍的領域大小變化中保持不變。權重衰減在12K參數下重現了Omnigrok倒U形，這是對比率測量的正控制。Grokking還處於數值的刀刃邊緣：浮點環境的兩個擾動 -- CPU線程數（減少順序）和CPU與GPU執行 -- 各自翻轉少數相同種子的結果，而不會在總體比率中檢測到變化。將其分解為子任務專家主要是通過降低覆蓋成本來幫助，而不是通過增加監督。在方法論上，固定數字環境下的多種子控制推翻了我們自己數據中的三個戲劇性的單次運行敘述，每個都是種子混淆。因此，grokking的證據單位必須是在固定數字環境下的多種子比率，並在可能的情況下與模型的直接讀取進行檢查。
2607.05104.author: Yoshiyuki Ootani et.al.
